titles.title: Survivre dans la peau d'un GwangGong !
เมื่อผมต้องรับบทพระเอกตัวร้าย!

description:
I possessed the body of the “gwang-gong” inside a BL game my junior made. The name was the same, but there was absolutely nothing in common between Gwak Seon-woo the deranged villain and Gwak Seon-woo the ordinary citizen.

A house entirely black with no signs of human life. A fridge stocked only with energy drinks and liquor.

“Ack—cold!”  
< You have uttered something unsuitable for a gwang-gong. Gwang-gong score –9. >

Showers can only be taken using a sunflower-shaped showerhead, and the water temperature cannot be adjusted. He desperately craves hot chocolate, but the only coffee options allowed are espresso and americano.
Forget his comfort food—he can’t even choose a basic franchise sandwich. He must somehow protect his constantly cancelled mealtimes.

“Can’t I just… have one proper meal…?”

< Gwang-gong do not obsess over food. Gwang-gong score –2. >  
< Current gwang-gong score: 49 >  
< Status ailment triggered: Insomnia (score below 50)! Raise gwang-gong score to resolve. >

In this harsh world, the only person who can help a gwang-gong live something close to a human life is the main su! …Or so the system claims, but Seon-woo absolutely refuses to create any weird atmosphere. Unexplainable affection toward the main su, and uncontrollable rage the moment he sees the sub-gong.
Brushing off the emotions the system keeps pushing onto him, Seon-woo scrambles to pick from the choices.

‣ “Shut up!”  
‣ “Get lost!”  
‣ “Nonsense!”

…If only he could actually choose them.

*Note: Gwang-gong = Obsessive gong or yandere seme  
Main su = Main character su, MC uke
Sub-gong = Second gong, the second male lead*
